name: OSEE

cost.note: Pricing not published on the OffSec website for EXP-401; historically offered as a Black Hat USA in-person course at ~$5,000-$12,000+ depending on format/year. Learn One ($2,749/year) covers 200/300-level courses and may not include EXP-401. Contact OffSec directly for current pricing.

levelNote: Score weights the required training as well as the exam: EXP-401 is rated Expert by OffSec, its most advanced course. Exam-only score 93, +4 for the training. level measures the depth a credential demands, not only how the exam checks it.

name: OSCE³

cost.note: OSCE3 is automatically awarded at no additional cost upon earning all three component certifications: OSEP (PEN-300), OSWE (WEB-300), and OSED (EXP-301). Each component cert costs $1,749 as a Course + Cert Bundle (or $2,749/year via Learn One). Total cost is approximately $5,247 if purchasing three separate Course + Cert Bundles, but there is no standalone OSCE3 exam or fee. OSCE3 does not expire.

levelNote: Composite credential, awarded for holding its component certifications. No training weight applied — that would count the components' courses twice.

name: OSAI

cost.note: Course + Cert Bundle: $1,749 (90 days lab access, 1 exam attempt). Learn One annual subscription: $2,749/year (1 year access, 2 exam attempts). Passing the AI-300 exam awards both OSAI (no expiry) and OSAI+ (expires 3 years). Course launched March 2026. AI/LLM tools are permitted during the exam.

levelNote: AI security is roughly three years old as a discipline and its credentials have not yet accumulated the depth of the established expert-tier certs. The whole column was re-rated together on that basis. AI-300 is a 300-level OffSec course, so it sits above the 200-level line — but not fully level with OSEP, OSWE and OSED. Those are 671, 105 and 932 content hours with 48-hour exams; AI-300 is 65 hours with a 24-hour exam. The course number marks the family and prerequisite, not equivalent depth. Top of the AI column on the strength of that practical and an OSCP-level prerequisite.
